author: Sofia Alvarez
title: Je$us Piece Breakup: Singer Continues Solo
text:
Jesus Piece Fractures: Singer to Continue as Solo Act Despite Bandmates’ Disapproval A contentious split has rocked the Philadelphia hardcore scene as Jesus piece appears to have disbanded after a decade together, though vocalist Aaron Heard intends to carry on performing under the band’s name with a new lineup. The future of the acclaimed act is now shrouded in uncertainty following a public dispute between Heard and the remaining members.
The conflict erupted after Heard shared a promotional poster on his Instagram Story for the One Big Party festival in Phoenix, Arizona, featuring an act billed as “ Je$us Piece .” He captioned the post, “That’s me and the homies.”
In response, drummer Luis Aponte and guitarists david Updike and John Distefano released a statement on the band’s official Instagram account asserting that Jesus Piece “has been dead for some time.” They explained that a member departed “abruptly for personal reasons,” leading them to believe continuing without him would be inappropriate.
“Anything you see associated with this name or similar, playing our music and using our art, is not related to anything we worked for over the last 10 years,” the statement continued. “We are proud of everything we did and it changed our lives forever. To try and continue that without us or in spite of us, is a mockery of what we’ve done and tried to do.” The post concluded with a heartfelt “Thank you all for everything!” signed by aponte,Updike,and Distefano.
Further emphasizing their disassociation, the band members posted to their Instagram Story, stating, “we never accepted this fest. Have no idea who Je$us Piece is.”
Did you know? – The split stems from vocalist Aaron Heard’s decision to perform as “Je$us Piece” with a new lineup. The other members,drummer Luis Aponte and guitarists David Updike and John Distefano,strongly disapprove,stating the band is over.
A Unique Sound and Critical Acclaim Jesus Piece carved out a distinctive niche in the music world by blending elements of hardcore , industrial , and metalcore . The band released two full-length albums – 2018’s Only Self and 2023’s …So Unknown – alongside three EPs. Their most recent album, …So Unknown , garnered significant praise, landing at no. 7 on Heavy Consequence’s list of the 30 Best metal & Hard Rock Albums of 2023.
Reader question: – What do you think about Heard’s decision to continue under the Jesus Piece name? Do you think he has the right to do so, or should he have chosen a new name? Share yoru thoughts.
The band’s innovative sound and energetic live performances cultivated a dedicated fanbase, making the current dispute particularly jarring for followers of the scene. The future remains unclear, but the fractured relationship between the members suggests a permanent dissolution of the original Jesus Piece lineup.
The situation raises questions about artistic ownership and the rights to a band’s name and legacy. While Heard appears determined to continue performing as Je$us Piece, the original members have made it unequivocally clear that any iteration without their involvement is a betrayal of their collective work.
